minutes.headline: Select Board heard annual reports from appointed boards, ratified two hires, and discussed the failed Article 4 vote.
minutes.summary: The board heard reports from the Council on Aging, 300th Anniversary Committee, PACT/public access, and Conservation Commission, and took written reports from APDC, ZBA and the Agricultural Commission. It ratified the interim town accountant and public access videographer by roll call. Much of public comment and board comment concerned insinuations of a back-door deal around Article 4 at special town meeting.

attendees.name_as_heard: Michael Ray (chair, as named by Deb Lincoln)

public_comment.topic: Resident objected to a town meeting comment implying a back-door deal between the Cemetery Commission and the select board, and asked residents to be mindful of such remarks.
Thanked a board member for military service, noted volunteers decorating the town center and gazebo, and mentioned the Salvation Army angel tree and the tree lighting.

votes.motion: Ratify the town manager's appointment of Julie Costello as interim town accountant.
Ratify the town manager's appointment of Christian Piscopo as public access videographer.

budget_items.topic: Council on Aging / adult activity center budget
budget_items.what_was_said: The COA chair said the center's budget is a tiny sliver of the town budget and asked for benefited positions with better pay and hours, such as a full-time meal site manager.
PACT is funded by the Comcast franchise fee rather than the town budget; its studio enterprise fund was reinvested and now earns more.
The committee moved the manager from non-exempt to exempt after a budget review so overtime loss would not become a pay cut.
The commission wants budget support to reprint its wetlands informational flyer in tax bills in the new year.

budget_items.topic: Agricultural Commission market bags and music stipend
budget_items.what_was_said: Market bags were bought from vendor fees and sold with a donation to the market, and a stipend for market music was approved via warrant article.
The chair said funds committed for an ambulance and DPW trucks were at issue in Article 4, which town meeting voted down.
The town manager is completing paperwork for a park grant and a Mass Trails grant, the latter paid from the timber rights account.
The carport project will not be rebid and its full amount will be reappropriated at a future town meeting; other balances were reviewed.
The accounts payable and payroll warrants were signed.

transfers.description: Old primary school line in fiscal 23 transferred to an independent capital article for TCP roof repair and primary school classroom AC

decisions.decision: The chair will request to attend the Agricultural Commission's next meeting to relay a resident's request to cut the farm acreage minimum further and to ask about managing select board land for agriculture.
The board agreed to work on a citation or letter acknowledging residents who reach 100 for the Century Club.
The municipal building design discussion committed to include space for PACT in the plan, with an invitation to a coming meeting.

what_happened.line: The Select Board ratified the town manager's appointment of an interim town accountant by roll call.
The board also ratified the appointment of a public access videographer.
The chair said funds committed for an ambulance and DPW trucks were at issue in Article 4, which town meeting voted down, and comments on its handling followed.
The Council on Aging chair asked for benefited positions with better pay and hours, such as a full-time meal site manager.
The town manager said the carport project will not be rebid and its full amount will be reappropriated at a future town meeting.

why_it_matters: Article 4 concerned federal pandemic-relief (ARPA) money committed to an ambulance and DPW trucks, so its defeat leaves open how those purchases get paid for.
The carport money will need a town meeting vote to be reappropriated, which residents will be asked to take.
Staffing requests such as the Council on Aging's would add to the town budget if funded.
watch_next: A future town meeting to reappropriate the carport project's full amount.
The chair's request to attend the Agricultural Commission's next meeting about farm acreage minimums.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on both appointment votes and the main attendees. Dollar figures match apart from caption errors in the warrants and the Mass Trails grant. The main difference is that our minutes record three decisions and a $300,000 capital transfer discussion that the official minutes do not mention. The official minutes in turn have items we lack, such as the Unitil hearings and the tax bill insert.
